quest.title: Equivalent Exchange
quest.description: Viktor is looking for someone to help him gather some local specialties...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you sell any Mondstadt specialties?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Mondstadt's specialties? What can I say, every last one of our dishes is unique to Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: However, most of them have a short shelf life, and are by no means convenient items to bring on a long trip.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: We can of course cook them differently to make them more suitable for travel and storage, but it comes at a significant compromise in taste and quality.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Doesn't bother me.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Alright then, if you insist.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: But if this is intended as a gift, I'd advise you to cook a fresh batch of whatever you choose — everything here has been sat out for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Might I ask where your friend is from? Perhaps I can make a recommendation.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Wow, that's a long way from here. I need to be careful with my choice of ingredients.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Hmm, I know nothing of Snezhnayan tastes, but I do know a dish that caters to all tastes.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Make me a Satisfying Salad and I will process it for you to make it more durable.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Huh, you know something, I can't actually remember the last time I had to get the tools for this job out of the cupboard.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: The F—Fatui? You mean the ones from Snezhnaya? ...Your social circle is broad, to put it mildly.

talks.objective: Make a Satisfying Salad and give it to Sara

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the specialty dish...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: How's the Satisfying Salad coming along? I'm ready when you are, just bring it right here when it's done.

talks.objective: Make a Satisfying Salad and give it to Sara

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Uh-oh, this Satisfying Salad is somewhat... unsatisfactory...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Why don't you have another try?

talks.objective: Make a Satisfying Salad and give it to Sara

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: This Satisfying Salad is not bad at all.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: As discussed, here's your specialty dish.

talks.objective: Make a Satisfying Salad and give it to Sara

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: This Satisfying Salad is not bad at all.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: As discussed, here's your specialty dish.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you sell any Mondstadt specialties?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Specialties? You're looking for a gift? Hmm, but I only sell flowers, which don't stay fresh for very long. They'll wilt very quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: The only other thing I can think of is to make a flower bookmark. I sometimes make them as gifts for my friends.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: They aren't worth a lot in monetary terms, but maybe they have some sentimental value... If you're interested, I suppose I can make one for you.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: But first, you must answer my question. Answer correctly, and I will make a bookmark for you.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: It's a very easy question. Here goes: Is the Dandelion a flower?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Wow, you answered that so quickly! Hoo-hoo, you certainly know a flower when you see one.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Here you go, here's your bookmark. Handmade by me from a dried Windwheel Aster. If this doesn't count as a Mondstadt specialty, I don't know what does!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: ...Wrong! Actually, Dandelions are flowers. Don't you know a flower when you see one?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Hmph. Well, I'm not giving you a bookmark that easily. Not to someone who's such an ignoramus on horticulture.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: I'll make you a deal. If you bring me some Dandelion Seeds, I'll trade them for the bookmark.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Also, promise me that while you're collecting the seeds, you'll repeat this in your head: "Dandelions are flowers, Dandelions are flowers"!

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: The ingredients definitely should have arrived by now... I hope nothing's happened. Perhaps you could go check up on the delivery?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Don't worry, whatever happens, I will try to find some way of making a Mondstadt specialty beverage for you.

talks.objective: Give the Dandelion Seeds to Flora

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About these Dandelion flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Have you got the Dandelion Seeds?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have them here.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Yep, that's them! Great. And in return, here's your bookmark.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Flower bookmarks are very fragile, and very easily lost. I'll box it for you, just don't go opening it unless you have to.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: It's a shame you can't make bookmarks out of Dandelion Seeds...

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Hello? May I help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you sell any Mondstadt specialties?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: You're looking to buy some wine? Hmm, you seem underage to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's for a friend.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Oh, it's for a friend, is it? So you'll take it back to your "friend," and then your "friend" will kindly invite you to share a drink with them, is that right?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: You can forget about purchasing alcohol — but, if you were genuinely here to purchase a Mondstadt specialty, we do have another beverage that might suit your requirements.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Ah, except... the only thing is, some of the ingredients that it's mixed with haven't arrived yet.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: They definitely should have arrived by now... I hope nothing's happened. Perhaps you could go check up on the delivery?

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: Don't worry, whatever happens, I will try to find some way of making a Mondstadt specialty beverage for you.

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: Just salvage whatever you can and bring it back here.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Ah, back from your intrepid adventure, I see... So, what did you manage to find?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: What's the situation?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The cart is wrecked.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: This was all you managed to salvage, was it? Never mind, I'll raise it with Master Diluc next time he's here.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: These monster attacks are going to impact business at the tavern if they continue much longer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's what I managed to salvage.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: *sigh* Thanks... It's a shame, you know, this was my first time ordering these particular ingredients. I had planned on experimenting around with some new cocktails.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Alright, now to make you a Mondstadt special, let's see what we have here... Okay, I should be able to work with these. One moment.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's all.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Alright. Good, in fact, because I don't have anything else I can share with you without getting both of us in trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Unless you have any other business, you'd better leave me alone now. I need to be available in case something suddenly comes up that needs my attention.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: *sigh* When will I get to head home?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Give Good Hunter's Specialty Dish)

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Food? But dried for ease of transport, not bad... I'll bet it doesn't taste great, though.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Still counts as a Mondstadt specialty though! Haha, yes, I'll definitely find someone back home to give this to.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Nice job, you're alright at this. Okay, now's the time to ask any burning questions you have.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Signora.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I might have guessed you'd ask about her. But I'm afraid I don't know much, and in fact I have my own questions...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: My superiors sent me to Mondstadt to work for Signora, but I haven't received a single assignment from her since I arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I heard through the grapevine that she didn't stick around long after she arrived, and that she was in a particularly good mood when she left...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: So I don't get it — is her business here finished? And if so, does that mean I get to go home yet, or what?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: My daily routine consists of me standing here being glared at by the sisters and the knights. It's really starting to give me the creeps...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Give Flora's Bookmark)

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: What's this? A bookmark...? Hmm. It'll do, I suppose. It works as an ornament.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I knew I'd picked the right person for the job. Okay, now's the time to ask any burning questions you have.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you leaving soon?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Me? I mean, I'd sure like to. Mondstadt bores me to tears, and I have had a grand total of zero assignments to occupy me in my whole time here.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I spend all my days sat here, with the sisters glaring at me every two seconds, as if I've just committed some sort of grave sin and they're livid with me about it.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Meanwhile, the delegation staying at the Goth Grand Hotel are in some sort of lockdown, so I don't hear so much as a peep from the inside.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: If you ask me, they should call us back home pronto if Signora's business here is done. The Mondstadters despise us, so we're only looking for trouble by staying here.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: But I haven't heard a word from my superiors, so I don't know what to think.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Give Specialty Beverage)

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Hey, check it out... It looks good in the bottle, but let me see how it tastes—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're supposed to cool it first.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Really? In that case, I'll wait till I get back home. Much easier to get hold of ice cubes back home...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I've said it before and I'll say it again, we Fatui always deliver on our promises. You've helped me out, and you will not go unrewarded.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: So ask away, whatever burning question you have.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you know about the other Harbingers?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: The Harbingers? They're way above my level. I'm lucky if I hear the odd rumor.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: For what it's worth, I can pass on what others have told me. But I advise you to take it with a pinch of salt.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I hear Harbinger No. 6, also known as Scaramouche, is difficult to get along with. A lot of people are not fans of his.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Why? Some say he just has a disagreeable personality. Others say it's because he doesn't know when to keep his mouth shut...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I know someone who works closely with the guy. He says Scaramouche is even disliked by several of his fellow Harbingers.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: But I mean, like him or not, he's still a Harbinger. He's doing an awful lot better than a rank-and-file member of the Fatui like me...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Something else bothering you? Come out and say it, don't beat about the bush.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Hah, now there's a half-decent question. Because... Because before long, everyone else in Mondstadt is going to be baying for Fatui blood, that's why.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: It used to be that the sisters would shoot me the odd sideways glance. Now, the whole city looks at me like they're ready to grab their pitchforks and have at me.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: So you tell me — if not a traveler like you, then who else could I trust to help me out in this place?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I'm at quite a loss to explain just what I must have done to get everyone here so riled up...

choices.text: How many other Fatui are currently in the city?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I don't have the exact figure. But what I do know is that the party staying in the Goth Grand Hotel is keeping itself locked inside these days. I don't know what's happened.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: At a guess, I would say that maybe the higher-ups are making a move again. But whatever... It's not like any of that affects people down at my level.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Okay. So, the base is apple vinegar, then we add some Dandelion, Mint, and Berries for flavor. Best served ice-cold.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: After a glass of this, simply breathe in and you will acutely feel the signature winds of Mondstadt on the insides of your cheeks and at the back of your throat.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Let me bottle that for you, otherwise it quickly loses its flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Don't forget: It's best served chilled.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Don't forget: It's best served chilled.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Give Specialty Beverage)

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Hey, check it out... It looks good in the bottle, but let me see how it tastes—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're supposed to cool it first.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Really? In that case, I'll wait till I get back home. Much easier to get hold of ice cubes this way...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I've said it before and I'll say it again, we Fatui always deliver on our promises. You've helped me out, and you will not go unrewarded.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: So ask away, whatever burning question you have.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you know about the other Harbingers?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: The Harbingers? They're way above my pay grade. I'm lucky if I hear the odd rumor.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: For what it's worth, I can pass on what others have told me. But I advise you to take it with a pinch of salt.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Have you heard of Childe? Word has it that this Harbinger travels often and will bring gifts to his family when he comes back.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Someone I know told me that he heard that the younger brothers and sisters of Master Childe all really like him.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: *sigh* But I don't want to be transferred to work for him, given that I might have to hustle everywhere again.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Please let the people above me show kindness and send me somewhere nice and warm, so that I can grow old in peace there...
